what: A six-channel groovebox. Each channel is a synth or a drum kit, with a sequencer of 1 to 8 bar patterns, loop recording, scenes you launch live, songs, and scales on the keys. Bluetooth MIDI and a web editor.
author: nullwave
sounds: CC0: Versilian Studios VSCO-2 CE and VCSL (piano, flute, tenor sax); the drum break is synthesised
